- Build a complete, playable 2D Zelda-style dungeon game with bomb puzzles.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game using HTML Canvas, with three connected rooms, bombable cracked walls, a key-and-vault progression, enemies, and touch controls.

- Created the game interface and mechanics in `index.html` and `game.js`.

- None.

1. Inspect the active browser screenshot/state and use the restart/start controls or reload to begin a clean playtest.
2. Verify movement, bomb destruction of cracked walls, key pickup, vault entry, and victory; fix any issues found.
3. Run `node --check game.js` and report the game plus the assumption of a three-room dungeon.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, HUD, intro/help overlays, responsive styles, and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, movement, bombs, room progression, enemies, and win/loss logic.

- Local HTTP server was started in tmux on port 3002; `playwright-cli open --headed http://localhost:3002` opened the game.
